Subject: MAP Kickoff — NimbleCare marketplace onboarding & evaluation plan

Hi Sara and Linda,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the mutual action plan (MAP) for NimbleCare’s cloud listing and the evaluation program. Quick intro from our side: I’m Jonas (Redwood Partner Ops) and I’ll be coordinating timeline and commercial milestones. Marissa (cc) will handle listing/marketing assets and Sergio will own the technical evaluation support.

Attached: NimbleCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft) — high-level milestones and owner columns.

Suggested high-level timeline (flexible):
- Sep 20 — Evaluation environment provisioned / test credentials delivered
- Sep 22–Oct 4 — Technical evaluation (performance, latency, integration smoke tests)
- Oct 5 — Evaluation signoff (PO or go/no-go)
- Oct 20 — Target marketplace listing date (AWS/GCP depending on final routing)

Asks for you to confirm by EOD Friday:
1) Primary contacts for procurement, security, and marketplace ops on NimbleCare’s side (names + email).
2) Confirm whether you want us to route listing through AWS Marketplace or via the partner publisher on your behalf (Sara, is ClearPublisher the preferred path?).
3) Any mandatory procurement paperwork or security questionnaires we should prioritize?

Sara: could you confirm your AWS marketplace technical contact so we can align on onboarding steps? Linda: would procurement be able to target the PO by Oct 5 under the proposed cadence?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Partner Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
(attachment: NimbleCare_MAP_v1.xlsx)
From: Sara Park <sara@clearpublisher.com>

Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 11:05:23 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff — NimbleCare marketplace onboarding & evaluation plan

Thanks Jonas — happy to kick this off.

Quick answers:
- ClearPublisher is fine to manage the listing; we also work closely with AWS Marketplace when customers prefer a direct marketplace listing.
- Primary AWS contact for onboarding is Jesse Lin (jesse@awsmarketplace.com) — I’ll loop him in on the checklist.
- I’ve attached our standard onboarding checklist for AWS listings (aws_onboarding_checklist.pdf) — it should help align the technical requirements and artifact windows.

For testing, we typically need:
- A short-term test license or eval key from Redwood
- An AMI or docker image from you (if listing as a marketplace AMI/container)
- A sample dataset and basic integration guide (for smoke tests)

I’ll coordinate ClearPublisher tasks for packaging and marketing assets; Marissa, can your team share brand/technical assets by Sep 24?

On timing, Jesse indicates AWS has a 10–14 business day standard review for new listings once all artifacts are submitted, so the Oct 20 target is tight but feasible if we keep to the timeline.

—Sara
Sara Park
Partner Lead, ClearPublisher
sara@clearpublisher.com
(attachment: aws_onboarding_checklist.pdf)

Hi Jonas / Sara — thanks for the plan and the checklist. A few notes from NimbleCare legal/procurement:

1) Procurement timeline: our procurement team needs two weeks after receiving final contract/quote to issue a PO. Realistically they can target Oct 1 for a PO if we receive final terms by Sep 17.
2) Security: we have a short security questionnaire (see link in the drive; I’ll upload if helpful). SOC2 report is required for production access — will Redwood be able to provide a current SOC2 Type II report during the evaluation?
3) Technical eval: our platform team needs an isolated test account and a small synthetic dataset to run throughput and latency tests. Can Redwood provide a time-limited eval key and an endpoint?

Contacts on our side:
- Linda Ortiz (tl; IT) — linda@nimblecare.com
- Alex Garcia (integration lead) — alex.garcia@nimblecare.com
- Procurement: procurement@nimblecare.com

If these pieces line up, procurement should be able to move to PO around Oct 1–4.

Thanks,
Linda Ortiz
Head of IT, NimbleCare

Hi all — looping in the technical evaluation plan details so NimbleCare engineering has a clear checklist. I’ll own the eval support and provide temporary credentials.

Planned technical deliverables from Redwood:
- Temporary eval account: eval+nimblecare@redwood.com (expires 2026-10-06)
- Test endpoint: https://eval-nimblecare.redwood-inference.com (read-only for tests)
- Sample dataset: synthetic_nimblecare_v1.tar.gz (S3 link will be shared)
- Performance targets for the evaluation: 95th pct latency < 350ms for 1–2k token workloads; throughput baseline on p4d equivalent.

Suggested evaluation steps:
1) Sep 22 — provisioning completed and smoke tests run (connectivity + API auth)
2) Sep 23–29 — perf runs and integration test cases (we will share exact scripts)
3) Sep 30–Oct 1 — review results, adjust config if needed

Action owners: Sergio (Redwood) — provisioning and endpoint; Marissa — marketing/asset handoff; Sara/ClearPublisher — packaging/listing; Linda/Alex — integration & procurement.

Attachment: evaluation_playbook.md (internal-friendly checklist and runbook).

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Lead Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: evaluation_playbook.md)
